clips.title: The story
paras: In Blackfathom Deeps, Gelihast guards a strange altar in the flooded Pool of Ask'ar. His Blindlight murlocs gather around him in the sunken temple.

Deep beneath the Zoram Strand, Gelihast has claimed a lair in Blackfathom Deeps. Most murlocs keep to coastal shallows, but he strikes at intruders with twin swords, moving too quickly for many to react. Casters who come within his reach rarely survive.

Gelihast rules the Pool of Ask'ar with his Blindlight brood, who swarm to his side at the first sign of trouble. An altar stands beyond his lair. Those who defeat him and touch it receive the Blessing of Blackfathom.
